summary: Fixed the `listInsights()` multi-store branch in `mcp-server/src/tools/knowledge.ts` to apply `limit` and `offset` globally after merging and deduplicating results from all stores, rather than forwarding them per-store. This closes the last known pagination correctness gap: a `limit=N` request now returns at most N results regardless of how many stores are configured. Four new integration tests cover the corrected behavior and codify the pre-existing correctness of `searchInsights()`.
